Open across the Americas and Europe.<br><strong>Hours:</strong> Full-time overlap with Pacific or Eastern time. This is a requirement, not a preference.<br><strong>Type:</strong> Independent contractor, full time<br><strong>Apply:</strong> [talent@rovenext.com]<br><br><strong>About the role</strong><br><br>Rove Next is a new premium line from Rove Concepts, a Vancouver-based modern furniture brand selling direct to consumer across Canada and the US. Rove Next launches with improved versions of our best-selling pieces, and it needs its own marketing built from the ground up.<br><br>That's this role. You'll own how Rove Next reaches customers and keeps them, starting with email and lifecycle. The goal is a marketing function that scales through AI and systems rather than through headcount, and the advantage here is that you're building it clean rather than inheriting one.<br><br>This is not a coordination role. We need someone who takes a problem and builds the answer, and who catches things before they reach leadership.<br><br><strong>Scope</strong><br><br>Initially focused on Rove Next, with room to expand across the Rove Concepts group as the brand grows.<br><br><strong>What you'll own</strong><br><br>Email and lifecycle as our primary owned channel. Campaign calendar, flows, segmentation, deliverability, list health. We run on Klaviyo.<br><br>Quality control on everything that ships. Copy, creative, link destinations, offers, regional versions. If something goes out wrong, it was yours to catch.<br><br>Building AI into the daily work. Not proposing it, shipping it.<br><br>Working alongside our lifecycle and email team, our designers, and our external ads partner to keep the calendar moving.<br><br>Translating results into plain business language. What we spent, what we made, what we'd do differently.<br><br><strong>Must-haves</strong><br><br>Five or more years in ecommerce or DTC marketing with real ownership of email and lifecycle. Klaviyo or a comparable ESP.<br><br>Evidence that you build with AI yourself rather than assigning it. When you hit a wall, your instinct should be to build through it, not to raise a ticket and wait.<br><br>Fluent, native-level English, written and spoken. This one is non-negotiable. You will be writing copy that goes out to our customers under our name, so we need someone who can hear the difference between a line that sounds premium and one that sounds like a discount retailer.<br><br>A strong eye. You can look at an asset and tell whether the destination matches the promise, whether the tone is right, and whether the offer math actually adds up.<br><br>Comfortable being told when something isn't landing, and comfortable telling us the same.<br><br><strong>Nice to have</strong><br><br>Furniture, home, or another considered-purchase category with a long buying cycle. Shopify, GA4 and Meta Ads familiarity. Experience holding a team to brand guidelines.<br><br><strong>What success looks like</strong><br><br>Flow revenue grows as a share of total email revenue. Work stops reaching leadership with errors in it. AI is doing measurable work inside the function within 90 days, rather than sitting in a proposal.<br><br><strong>Compensation</strong><br><br>$3,500 to $4,500 USD per month depending on experience. Independent contractor.<br><br><strong>How to apply</strong><br><br>Send your CV to [talent@rovenext.com]. In a few lines, tell us two things:<br><br>One AI workflow or automation you built yourself in a real business.
